label: Active Students
description: Students with course activity in the course window
longDescription: Students with an available, enabled enrollment and course activity inside the course window, in courses that have an instructor and have not been deleted.
prompt: How many active students do we have, broken down by term? Which terms stand out?

label: Student Engagement
description: Share of student enrollments with course activity
longDescription: Share of student enrollments with course activity in the course window.
prompt: What is the student engagement rate by term and by course design mode? Where is it lowest?

label: Active in the Last 7 Days
description: Share of students in ongoing courses who accessed them this week
longDescription: Share of students with an active enrollment in an ongoing course whose last course access was in the last 7 days.
prompt: What share of students in ongoing courses were active in the last 7 days, by course? Which courses have the lowest share?

label: Courses with Student Activity
description: Reportable courses where students have been active
longDescription: Reportable courses where at least one student has had course activity in the course window.
prompt: How many courses have student activity, by term? What share of reportable courses is that?

label: Classic Courses
description: Top-level courses still in the Original course view
longDescription: Top-level courses still in the Original (Classic) course view.
prompt: How many courses are still in the Classic course view, by term? How does that compare to Ultra?

label: Average Grade
description: Average course grade across graded enrollments
longDescription: Average course grade percentage across graded student enrollments in reportable courses.
prompt: What is the average grade by term and by grade band? Which terms have the most failing students?
